card.name: Inside transliterated Hebrew religious names
card.fires_on: Partway through transliterated Hebrew words in Jewish religious texts, such as Talmud tractate names, biblical names and blessings. It fires on the middle or ending piece, like os, ot, it or ua.

modes.label: Talmud and book titles
modes.description: Middle or final piece of a transliterated tractate or book name, often followed by a page or verse number.
